column1: Each candidate product is scored against every Tier 1 variable: Status, a 0-100 Rating, and Comments. Leave cells blank where a product does not cover or touch a requirement. The Summary rolls up automatically - including Footprint (how much of the requirement universe the product reaches). Our Posture shows the Tier 1 boundary, so where a product does more than we want (e.g. automates a Read item) the risk is visible. Definitions are in the Column key below.

column4: The variable being scored - same codes as Tabs 1 and 2.
Carried from Tier 1: the day-one must-have flag, the knockout flag, and where a product may conflict with how Compassus works.

The boundary we set in Tier 1: Control (software may drive it), Assist (software proposes, a person confirms), or Read (software only surfaces; a person decides). A product that does more than this on a variable is a risk to our determined interest - note it in Comments.
Where the product stands: Not Available, Dev Roadmap, Testing, Active with Issues, Active, or In Scope Not Seen. Blank = not covered / not touched.
0-100 score for how well the product handles the variable.
Evidence and notes from the product guide, demo, or vendor answer - including any place the product oversteps Our Posture.
Weighted share of the requirement universe the product touches at all (any Status except Not Available) - how much of what we care about it even reaches.
